backups.subtitle: Force extra configuration reads per group without waiting for Oxidized's global interval.
backups.howItWorks: A schedule queues a backup (an immediate read in Oxidized) for all nodes or a single group every N minutes. It does not replace the Oxidized interval: if you want the cadence you already configured, you do not need a schedule. It is only useful to request extra reads on a different cadence, for example every 6 h for a critical group.

ssh_no_exec.help: Opens an SSH shell without an exec channel.

ssh_proxy.label: SSH proxy
ssh_proxy.help: Jump host used to reach the device.

comware_cmdline.label: Comware command line
comware_cmdline.help: Command line adjustment for Comware models.

cumulus_use_nclu.label: Cumulus NCLU
cumulus_use_nclu.help: Uses NCLU to retrieve Cumulus configuration.

cumulus_use_nvue.label: Cumulus NVUE
cumulus_use_nvue.help: Uses NVUE to retrieve Cumulus configuration.

fullconfig.label: Full config
fullconfig.help: Requests the full configuration when supported.

ios_rbac.label: IOS RBAC
ios_rbac.help: Adjusts collection for IOS with RBAC.

exec.label: Run command
exec.help: Runs a local command when an event occurs.

githubrepo.label: GitHub repository
githubrepo.help: Publishes changes to a GitHub repository.

awssns.label: AWS SNS
awssns.help: Publishes events to an Amazon SNS topic.

slackdiff.label: Slack diff
slackdiff.help: Sends the configuration diff to Slack.

ciscosparkdiff.label: Webex diff
ciscosparkdiff.help: Sends the configuration diff to Webex.

xmppdiff.label: XMPP diff
xmppdiff.help: Sends the configuration diff to an XMPP room.

maintenance.subtitle: Pause scheduled backups, retries and alerts during a maintenance window.
maintenance.newWindowDescription: Pick the scope and the time range.
maintenance.hint: During the window, scheduled backups and retries are skipped and staleness and configuration-change alerts are muted. Oxidized keeps polling on its own interval.
maintenance.emptyDescription: No maintenance is active or scheduled.

compliance.subtitle: Compare each node's current configuration against a template and detect deviations.
compliance.templatesDescription: One global, group or model template. Priority is group, model, then global.
compliance.name: Name
compliance.reportDescription: Evaluate nodes with the template that applies to them.
compliance.emptyDescription: Add a template or adjust the filters.

templates.subtitle: Create new nodes from proven settings (model, group, input and variables).
templates.listDescription: No passwords are stored; creation reuses the group credential or the one you set on the node.
templates.createDescription: Set the defaults applied when a node is created.
templates.name: Name
templates.applyHelp: The node and its configuration are created; the password is inherited from the group or can be added later.

reconciliation.subtitle: Compare Oxidized's inventory with the console and detect orphans and differences.
reconciliation.missingInUiDescription: They exist in Oxidized but not in the console. Import the ones you want to manage here.
reconciliation.noMissingDescription: Every Oxidized node is in the console.
reconciliation.driftTitle: Differences between Oxidized and the console
reconciliation.driftDescription: The console is the configuration source; review these differences before re-applying.
reconciliation.missingInOxidizedDescription: They are in the console but Oxidized no longer loads them. Review them before deleting.

reports.title: Weekly reports
reports.description: Summary of backups, failed jobs, configuration changes and compliance.
reports.help: Stored under data/reports and, when an export target exists, uploaded too. The report.ready event notifies channels.
reports.emailFailed: The email could not be sent; check the SMTP configuration.

health.title: System health
health.description: Disk, database, Oxidized data and job queue.

sites.title: Sites
sites.subtitle: Group the inventory by location and see the health of each site.
sites.emptyDescription: Add the Site tag (or any other) to nodes to group them here.
sites.mapDescription: One marker per site; open it to see every device.
sites.mapHelp: Set coordinates from the site card. Formats: 36.751112, -3.491751 or 36°45'04.0"N 3°29'30.3"W.
sites.mapUnavailable: The map could not be loaded. The server cannot reach OpenStreetMap; check its internet access or proxy.
sites.mapEmpty: No site has coordinates yet. Use the pencil on a card to place it on the map.
sites.editCoordinatesDescription: The position applies to every node in this site.
